抓娃娃机，方向键微调，空格下爪，Shift 加方向键旋转视角，点选娃娃瞄准: Claw machine. Arrow keys adjust aim; Space drops; Shift plus arrows rotates the view. Select a plush to aim.
拖动红色摇杆移动 · 点娃娃瞄准 · 空格下爪 · 拖空白旋转: Drag the red joystick to move · select a plush to aim · Space to drop · drag empty space to rotate
移动已停止；对准后可以下爪，或继续微调。: Movement stopped. Drop when aligned, or keep adjusting.
已经到达这一侧边缘，换个方向试试: At this edge. Try another direction.
先领取娃娃，再移动机械爪: Collect the plush before moving the claw
机械爪工作中，完成后才能移动: Claw operating. Movement unlocks when it finishes.
已经全部领取，点击“再玩一轮”: All collected. Choose Play another round.
正在移动，松开停止；对准后下爪。: Moving. Release to stop, then drop when aligned.
请等待当前抓取完成: Wait for the current capture to finish
红色摇杆，按住并拖动控制爪子，松开停止: Red joystick. Hold and drag to move the claw; release to stop.
摇杆已松开，爪子停止；对准后下爪。: Joystick released; claw stopped. Drop when aligned.
机械爪工作中，请等待这一轮结束: Claw operating. Wait for this round to finish.
摇杆控制中，松开立即停止。: Joystick active. Release to stop immediately.
已经到达边缘，换个方向试试: At the edge. Try another direction.
使用方向键移动爪子，空格下爪: Use arrow keys to move the claw and Space to drop
转一转，把快乐带回家。: Turn it and take a little joy home.
点娃娃自动瞄准，或按住红色摇杆拖动。松手停止，再按“下爪”。: Select a plush to auto-aim, or hold and drag the red joystick. Release to stop, then choose Drop.
拖动画面空白处旋转观察。先点选或聚焦模型，再用方向键微调、空格下爪；Shift: Drag empty space to rotate. Select or focus the model, then use arrows to adjust and Space to drop. Shift plus arrows rotates the view. Click the tray to collect a captured plush.
拖动旋转观察 · 点娃娃瞄准: Drag to rotate · select a plush to aim
点娃娃瞄准，或拖动红色摇杆。: Select a plush to aim, or drag the red joystick.
横向位置先锁定，吊索放长，让张开的爪子降到抓取高度。: The horizontal position locks first; the cable extends to lower the open claw to the grabbing height.
三根爪指合拢；只有爪心离娃娃足够近，这次演示才会抓住它。: The three fingers close. In this demonstration, the plush is caught only if the claw centre is close enough.
没有夹中娃娃，吊索空载收回。: The claw missed. The cable retracts without a load.
吊索收回，把已夹中的娃娃提离底板。: The cable retracts, lifting the captured plush off the floor.
这次落空了。爪子重新张开，停稳后便可调整位置再试。: Missed this time. The claw opens again; adjust and retry once it stops.
先提升再横移，桥架把娃娃送到固定投放口，不会直接穿过机器侧面。: Lift first, then move sideways. The bridge carries the plush to a fixed opening instead of passing through the side of the machine.
到达投放口后爪指张开，让娃娃落入机内滑道。: At the drop opening, the fingers open and the plush falls into the internal chute.
娃娃向下落入投放井，机械爪留在上方。: The plush falls into the drop shaft; the claw stays above.
娃娃沿底部滑道移动，最后出现在取物口托盘。: The plush travels along the lower chute and reaches the collection tray.
本轮已送达。领取娃娃后，横移机构才会回到起始位置。: Delivery complete. The traversing mechanism returns to its start only after collection.
领取后记录收集结果，随后机械爪自动回位。: Collection records the result, then the claw automatically returns.
桥架带着空爪回到起点；回位完成后，摇杆与方向键重新可用。: The bridge carries the empty claw home. The joystick and arrow keys unlock when it arrives.
横移机构沿两轴把爪心移向所选娃娃；停稳后才可下爪。: Two-axis travel positions the claw over the selected plush. It must stop before dropping.
摇杆与方向键改变两轴位置。松开或取消手势立即停止；到轨道边缘后不能继续向外。: The joystick and arrows change the two-axis position. Releasing or cancelling stops movement immediately. The rails prevent travel beyond their ends.
当前位置触到轨道行程边缘。向内移动仍然有效，不会越过机身。: The mechanism has reached its travel limit. It can still move inward and cannot pass through the body.
先用两轴对准娃娃，再垂直下爪；松开摇杆或方向键即停止手动移动。: Align on both axes before dropping vertically. Releasing the joystick or arrow keys stops manual movement.
手动松开即停；切出不续推: Release to stop; switching away does not keep moving
本轮自动完成；切出暂停，返回继续: Round runs automatically; switching away pauses it until return
读数对应导轨、吊索和爪指的当前状态。抓取保留原速，不改变按住移动或松手停止的手感: Readouts follow the rails, cable and fingers. Capture keeps its original speed and preserves hold-to-move and release-to-stop control.
看吊索变长：桥架不横移，张开的爪子向下。: Watch the cable extend: the bridge stays still as the open claw descends.
看三根爪指收拢；对照爪心与娃娃的位置。: Watch the three fingers close. Compare the claw centre with the plush position.
看空爪上升，没有娃娃随它离开底板。: Watch the empty claw rise. No plush leaves the floor with it.
看吊索缩短，夹中的娃娃跟着爪子上升。: Watch the cable retract as the captured plush rises with the claw.
看空爪重新张开；它不会被算作一次领取。: Watch the empty claw reopen. This does not count as a collection.
看上方导轨与桥架横移，娃娃随爪子到投放井上方。: Watch the upper rails and bridge move the plush above the drop shaft.
看爪指张开，娃娃离开爪子。: Watch the fingers open and the plush leave the claw.
看娃娃落入底板上的投放井，爪子仍停在上方。: Watch the plush enter the floor's drop shaft while the claw stays above.
看同一只娃娃从机内滑道出现在前方托盘。: Watch the same plush travel through the internal chute to the front tray.
看前方取物口；点击娃娃或下方按钮领取。: Look at the front tray. Click the plush or the button below to collect it.
看托盘上的娃娃被取走，随后空爪回位。: Watch collection from the tray, followed by the empty claw's return.
看桥架带空爪回到起点，不会再计一次领取。: Watch the bridge bring the empty claw home. This does not count as another collection.
看上方两轴导轨、桥架和底板上的瞄准圈；可点娃娃，或用原摇杆与方向键微调。: Look at the two-axis rails, bridge and aiming ring. Select a plush or adjust with the joystick and arrows.
等待这一轮完成: Wait for this round to finish
四只娃娃都已领取，机内没有可抓取目标。重新摆放会清空本轮尝试和收集记录。: All four plushes have been collected, leaving no target inside. Resetting clears this round's attempts and collection record.
刚才合爪时没有夹中。先调整爪心与娃娃的位置再下爪；系统不会替你改选目标。: The claw closed without a plush. Adjust its centre before dropping again; the system will not choose another target for you.
桥架已移到你选的娃娃上方。下爪后横向位置锁定，依次下降、合拢，再提升；也可先手动: The bridge is above your selected plush. Dropping locks its horizontal position, then lowers, closes and lifts the claw. You can adjust manually first.
当前轮次完成并领取后才能重新瞄准。: Finish and collect the current round before aiming again.
这只娃娃已领取，重新摆放后可再抓。: This plush has been collected. Reset the plushes to try it again.
使用原有点选瞄准；也可以直接操作模型、摇杆和方向键。: Use the existing click-to-aim control, or operate the model, joystick and arrows directly.
沿用原有重新摆放：当前轮次必须完成并领取；会清空本轮尝试与收集记录。: The existing reset requires the current round to finish and be collected. It clears this round's attempts and collection record.
看懂一步 · 瞄准与抓取: Follow one step · aim and capture
退出讲解 · 保留当前动作: Leave the explanation · keep the current action
按原速跟随当前动作，不设暂停关卡。抓取按爪心距离作简化判定，不模拟夹持力或传感器: Follow the current action at its original speed, without pause gates. Capture uses a simplified distance check, not gripping forces or sensors.
